offering_description.value: Manufactures, markets and distributes shelf-stable and frozen branded foods such as canned vegetables, beans, spices, syrups, hot sauces, peanut butter and frozen vegetables. Sells mainly to grocery retailers, foodservice operators and club and mass merchants, using own and contract manufacturing plants.

primary_products.value: canned vegetables and beans; spices and seasonings; maple and pancake syrups; frozen vegetables; sauces and condiments

customer_segment.value: B2B: supermarkets, mass merchants, club stores, foodservice operators, food distributors and wholesalers

end_markets.value: grocery retail; foodservice; packaged food consumers

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded packaged and frozen foods sold to retailers and foodservice customers

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets acquired food brands, sold to retailers and foodservice; OEM / manufacturer: produces foods in own plants and via co-packers from purchased agricultural and food ingredients

geography_served.value: North America: United States primarily, plus Canada and Mexico

specialization.value: related lines: shelf-stable, spices, syrups, sauces, and frozen foods sold to grocery and foodservice customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to major grocery chains, mass merchants and club stores; distributors / dealers: food distributors and wholesalers serving foodservice and smaller retailers; agents / brokers: food brokers representing products to retail accounts
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: food safety and labeling rules from FDA, USDA and Canadian authorities, environmental and workplace rules
